# NCTOH Workshop: Data Visualization

This page shows the main visualization examples used in the NCTOH workshop.

## Histograms and density plots

```{r, eval=FALSE}
ggplot(data = overall_age_u, aes(x = current_age)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 7, fill = "pink", color = "black")

ggplot(data = overall_age_u, aes(x = current_age, y = after_stat(density))) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "pink", color = "black")
```

## Bar charts and stacked bars

```{r, eval=FALSE}
overall_up |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = fuel_type, fill = tobacco_type)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent)
```

## Scatterplots and facets

```{r, eval=FALSE}
ggplot(data = df, aes(x = age, y = sbp, color = sex)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~ wealth_index)
```

## Themed figures

```{r, eval=FALSE}
plot1 +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
```

:::
